DEMO SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - not a real research source.
This note describes a hypothetical device inventory.
Each device has a unique identifier and an inspection date.
For this fictional example, records are stored in a local table
and checked monthly.
A record is current when the inspection date is less than
30 days old. If the date is older, the record is marked for review.
These statements are invented for interface testing and must
not be interpreted as real-world evidence.
